 PSG, best men's club of the 2026 season 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article PSG are crowned the best men's club of the 2026 season. 
 Paris Saint-Germain have been named the best men's club of the season, retaining last year's title. Luis Enrique's team won their second consecutive Champions League title after beating Arsenal on penalties in the final. Few teams in the competition's modern era had managed to win back-to-back European Cups, and PSG did so with a squad featuring ten Ballon d'Or nominees.
 OneFootball Videos
 The season also brought the UEFA Super Cup, Ligue 1 and the French Super Cup. The semi-final tie against Bayern, featuring a 5-4 first-leg win that has already gone down in tournament history, showcased the quality and character of a team that never gives up. With this award, PSG confirm that their dominance is not just a winning streak, but an era.
